hooks.command: jq -c 'def spam: ((.context.cwd // "") | test("\\.claude-mem/observer-sessions")) or (([.notification.title, .notification.subtitle, .notification.body] | map(. // "") | join(" ")) | test("observer-sessions"; "i")); if spam then .effects.desktop=false | .effects.sound=false | .effects.paneFlash=false | .effects.markUnread=false | .effects.reorderWorkspace=false else . end'
